targetTexts.1: A Psalm of Asaph. The Mighty One, God the LORD, speaks and summons the earth from where the sun rises to where it sets.
targetTexts.2: From Zion, perfect in beauty, God shines forth.
targetTexts.3: Our God approaches and will not be silent! Consuming fire precedes Him, and a tempest rages around Him.
targetTexts.4: He summons the heavens above, and the earth, that He may judge His people:
targetTexts.5: “Gather to Me My saints, who made a covenant with Me by sacrifice.”
targetTexts.6: And the heavens proclaim His righteousness, for God Himself is Judge. Selah
targetTexts.7: “Hear, O My people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will testify against you: I am God, your God.
targetTexts.8: I do not rebuke you for your sacrifices, and your burnt offerings are ever before Me.
targetTexts.9: I have no need for a bull from your stall or goats from your pens,
targetTexts.10: for every beast of the forest is Mine—the cattle on a thousand hills.
targetTexts.11: I know every bird in the mountains, and the creatures of the field are Mine.
targetTexts.12: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is Mine, and the fullness thereof.
targetTexts.13: Do I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
targetTexts.14: Sacrifice a thank offering to God, and fulfill your vows to the Most High.
targetTexts.15: Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor Me.”
targetTexts.16: To the wicked, however, God says, “What right have you to recite My statutes and to bear My covenant on your lips?
targetTexts.17: For you hate My instruction and cast My words behind you.
targetTexts.18: When you see a thief, you befriend him, and throw in your lot with adulterers.
targetTexts.19: You unleash your mouth for evil and harness your tongue to deceit.
targetTexts.20: You sit and malign your brother; you slander your own mother’s son.
targetTexts.21: You have done these things, and I kept silent; you thought I was just like you. But now I rebuke you and accuse you to your face.
targetTexts.22: Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you to pieces, with no one to rescue you:
targetTexts.23: He who sacrifices a thank offering honors Me, and to him who rightly orders his way, I will show the salvation of God.”
